body:
Words that reveal a person, mark a consequential choice, or give a lasting event its voice. Each line retains its speaker and links to the history that gives it meaning.

Loss, remembrance and survival

Choice and restraint

Care and responsibility

Faith, knowledge and authority

Identity and belonging

Power and its price

History and the world ahead

Why these lines remain

These lines hold a character’s convictions, contradictions or loss, or capture a turning point in the world’s history. Their context matters: a speaker’s belief remains their belief, even when the words are memorable.
